Nek'zali the Soulcoiler: [해제] Essence Rend is a Magic effect, so clear it yourself with Cloak of Shadows after reaching the edge of the room. A Latent Cultist spawns where it was removed.
[생존기] When soaking Hungering Pyre in the intermission, reduce the AoE damage with Feint.
@m [차단] If you are on the well-kill team, interrupt Drowned Echo's Soulcoiler's Curse with Kick.

Entombed Sentinels: [해제] Blighted Blood is a Magic effect, so you can clear it yourself with Cloak of Shadows.
[참고] The boss takes 99% less damage during Vitriolic Stasis, so hold Deathmark and Kingsbane until after the intermission.
[생존기] When soaking Unstable Miasma, reduce the AoE damage with Feint.

Vashnik the Malignant: [해제] Exploding Infection is a Magic effect, so you can clear it yourself with Cloak of Shadows. Clearing it sets off Caustic Explosion, so stagger with other dispels.
[우선 처치] AoE down the venom adds with Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest before they reach the center.
[제어] Burning Venom can be held with Blind until Hardened Venom.

The Lost Explorers: [차단] Interrupt Scrollsage Iku's Icebound Flames with Kick.
[해제] An Icebound Flames that lands after a missed interrupt is a Magic effect, so you can clear it yourself with Cloak of Shadows.
[우선 처치] Use Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest on the two stacked bosses so the damage also hits First Mate Nama.

Sszorak: [생존기] Sszorak takes more damage during the 25 sec Dig In, so line up Deathmark and Kingsbane with it.
[분담] When soaking Mutilate, reduce the AoE damage with Feint.
@m [위치] If To the Slaughter hits you and you get Virulence, spread out immediately with Sprint.

The Twin Fangs: [우선 처치] Kill the Venomous Emergence adds first with Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest.
[생존기] When soaking Ravenous Feast, reduce the AoE damage with Feint.
@m [차단] Interrupt Broodling of Ithraz's Visceral Burst and Caustic Globule's Barbed Bulwark with Kick.

The Coiled Altar: [우선 처치] Ghastly Regeneration in the intermission makes Zul'jan take 100% more damage, so dump Deathmark and Kingsbane.
[차단] Once the Veil of Twilight shield breaks, interrupt Eternal Nightfall with Kick.
[회피] After soaking Guillotine, immediately get 40 yards away from the axe with Sprint.

Ula'tek: [우선 처치] Dump Deathmark and Kingsbane into the Venomous Heart exposed after Rage of the Shackled.
[차단] Interrupt Malice, Anguished Cry, and Vicious Echoes with Kick.
[우선 처치] Break the Blightscale Spawn eggs with Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest so they become weak Blightscale Rawlings.

Nymrissa Wavecaller: [우선 처치] Kill the Bubblefin Shorerunners drawn in by Alluring Bubble with Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest before they reach the bubble.
[생존기] Line up Feint with the raid damage from Pop! and Unending Tides.
@m [우선 처치] Waterfog Shield reduces damage to nearby murlocs by 99%, so kill the Bubblefin Frostscale before using Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest.

Imperator Averzian: [차단] In the intermission, interrupt Pitch Bulwark from Shadowguard Stalwart and Voidbound Annihilator with Kick.
[우선 처치] AoE down the Voidmaw packs with Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest.
[생존기] Line up Feint with Dark Upheaval raid damage at the pull and after each intermission.

Vorasius: [해제] The Blisterburst damage taken increase and the Creep Spit movement slow are Magic effects, so you can clear them yourself with Cloak of Shadows.
[회피] During Void Breath, Sprint to the far end of the room opposite the glowing hand.
@m [생존기] When the first Blistercreep pack pops, reduce damage taken with Feint.

Fallen-King Salhadaar: [차단] Interrupt Shadow Fracture from the nearest Fractured Image with Kick or Kidney Shot.
[참고] The boss takes 25% more damage during the 20 sec Entropic Unraveling, so line up Deathmark and Kingsbane with it and reduce the raid damage with Feint.
[위치] If you are the Despotic Command target, immediately separate from others with Sprint and move to the room edge just before it ends.

Vaelgor & Ezzorak: [해제] Dread Breath fear is a Magic effect, so you can clear it yourself with Cloak of Shadows.
[차단] Interrupt Voidorb's Voidbolt with Kick or hold it with Kidney Shot.
[생존기] Midnight Flames raid damage lasts 25 sec, so line up Feint inside Radiant Barrier.

Lightblinded Vanguard: [해제] The Avenger's Shield DoT is a Magic effect, so you can clear it yourself with Cloak of Shadows.
[차단] After breaking War Chaplain Senn's Sacred Shield, interrupt Blinding Light with Kick.
[우선 처치] Right after the pull, stack your AoE with Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest on Commander Venel Lightblood, who takes more damage from Avenging Wrath.

Crown of the Cosmos: [해제] Corrupting Essence on a player is a Magic effect, so you can clear it yourself with Cloak of Shadows.
[참고] Dispelling Null Corona moves the remaining absorb to someone else, so do not use Cloak of Shadows on it unless it is an emergency.
[우선 처치] Kill the Void Droplets under the sentinel by hitting them together with the sentinel using Fan of Knives.

Chimaerus the Undreamt God: [차단] Interrupt Haunting Essence's Fearsome Cry first with Kick.
[해제] Fearsome Cry fear that slips past interrupts is a Magic effect, so you can clear it yourself with Cloak of Shadows.
[우선 처치] If you are on the lower floor team, save Deathmark and Kingsbane to break the adds' Alnshroud shields quickly.

Belo'ren, Child of Al'ar: [차단] If your feather color matches, interrupt the embers' Light Eruption or Void Eruption with Kick.
[분담] When soaking Light Dive or Void Dive with same-color players, reduce damage taken with Feint.
[생존기] During the Phase 2 egg's Rebirth, dump Deathmark and Kingsbane to burn down Immortal Flame.

Midnight Falls: @nh [차단] Interrupt the Safeguard Matrix's Safeguard casts with Kick and Kidney Shot to remove the stacks.
@m [차단] Interrupt Terminate from your assigned Termination Matrix in order with Kick.
[생존기] Line up Feint with the 25 sec of raid damage from Shattered Sky.

Rotmire: @hm [차단] Always interrupt Sporecap's Poison Burst with Kick.
[우선 처치] AoE down the Shroomlings and Bursting Shrooms gathered at the set spot with Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest.
[생존기] Line up Feint with the raid damage from Fungal Bloom and Bursting Pustules.

note: There is no spec-specific source for each raid boss, so these are general principles written by matching ability tooltips to boss mechanics.
